parameter_matrix.note: Wider operating Vin window supports broader rail & battery chemistry headroom.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: TPS7A0233PDBVR is rated to only 6 V rec. (6.5 V abs max, p.4) vs TPS70933DBVR at 30 V rec. (32 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: TPS70933DBVR supplies up to 150 mA (p.5) compared to TPS7A0233PDBVR at 200 mA (p.5); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs by 690 mV (TPS70933DBVR: 960 mV p.5 vs TPS7A0233PDBVR: 270 mV p.6); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo at cold/hot corners.
engineering_verdict: TPS70933DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TPS7A0233PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to Vin,max rating drops >20%; Iout,max rating drops >20%; dropout voltage headroom differs >= 500 mV. Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 1.3 µA (p.5) vs 0.025 µA (p.6), max output current is 150 mA (p.5) vs 200 mA (p.5), recommended Vin,max is 30 V (p.4) vs 6 V (p.5), typical dropout is 960 mV (p.5) vs 270 mV (p.6), and ceramic capacitor stability is supported vs supported. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 212.1 vs 181.9 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
